summary: Singly-linked-list walker. Reads the list head from this+0x0; if it is NULL it returns the head immediately. Otherwise it initializes an iterator field this+0x8 to the head, then walks the node chain calling FileSettingsScanner(node, a2) on each node and advancing the iterator to the next node (read through the +0x4 slot of the current node) until a NULL node is reached. Returns the final node pointer (null at normal chain end). Invoked during player-file initialization (caller PlayerFileInit 0x004B0540).

local_names.this: linked-list iterator object (head at +0x0, cursor at +0x8)

operations.description: If the list head at this+0x0 is NULL, skip the walk entirely and return that NULL value.
Load the head pointer into result (*this) and initialize the iterator field this+0x8 to the same head.
Enter the loop with the first node: result = *(head+0x0).
Iterate the node chain while the current node pointer is non-null, advancing to the next node pointer each pass.
For each node, invoke FileSettingsScanner(node, a2) to process the node's data.
Advance the iterator: reload result from this+0x8, read the next node through the current node's +0x4 slot (result[1]), store it back into this+0x8, and break the loop when it becomes NULL.
Return the final node pointer (NULL when the chain is exhausted or the head was NULL).
